messages:
support_jess: heads up — ACME tenant reporting ~18% 502s to hosted-inference since ~01:20Z. Started right after model-variant swap. Small requests (few tokens) failing, larger streams mostly fine. sample trace IDs: trace=abc123, trace=def456. can someone triage?
kevin_oncall: on it. any quick repro + curl?
support_jess: repro curl from customer: 
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'X-Model-Meta: eyJ2IjoiMTEiLCJtbyI6Im9wZW4tby10h...longbase64...==' \
  -d '{"inputs":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response: 502 and connection reset. they also attached envoy logs lines: `upstream_reset_before_response_started` and `UPSTREAM_CONNECTION_RESET`.
maria_ingress: seeing correlated spike in envoy error_count on frontdoor cluster for tenant ACME at 01:20Z. digging into headers.
sre_bot: alert: frontdoor-nginx-01 status increased 502_rate to 0.18 for route /v1/generate (ACME) — memory/CPU normal.
ops_raj: quick thought — we rolled a tiny midproxy header enrichment last week that adds `X-Model-Meta` containing model metadata (base64). Usually small but for some variants it's much larger. Envoy+nginx have header size limits; could be header truncate/reset on multiplexed h2 streams.
kevin_oncall: can you grep the logs for `longheader` or serialized length?
maria_ingress: found examples where header len > 16KB for a particular runtime variant. sample from request header size: 17492 bytes. envoy error: `http/2: header field too large`. That would explain 502s for short payloads — upstream rejects before body.
support_jess: customer says failure started after model swap to `gpt-open-small-v2` — that variant includes a detailed provenance blob in responses and our midproxy mirrored that as `X-Model-Meta`.
kevin_oncall: ok mitigation options: 1) temporary disable header enrichment for ACME (fast) 2) rollback model-variant (customer side) 3) increase envoy/nginx header limits (riskier). recommend 1 + 3 if we want durable fix.
ops_raj: pushed a quick config to midproxy to stop adding `X-Model-Meta` for tenants tagged `prod-sensitive` — deploying to canary now.
maria_ingress: canary looks good, 30 min no 502s on canary cluster for ACME sample traffic.
support_jess: telling customer to test canary endpoint and confirm.
customer_ops: confirmed: after switching to the canary (no meta header) their requests succeed. Thanks!
kevin_oncall: follow-ups: add validation for header size when generating enrichment, add a server-side truncation with a warning instead of sending huge base64, and add an alert on header_size 5xx correlation. I'll open tickets.
support_jess: filing customer post-mortem and escalation notes. tagging product to consider removing full provenance from header. :thumbsup:
ops_raj: created ticket INF-4123 to add header-size guard + INF-4124 to implement graceful truncation and metric.
kevin_oncall: closing loop — revert not needed, can close after infra rollout. leaving thread for documentation.
sre_bot: incident resolved: frontdoor-502-spike ACME — mitigated by disabling X-Model-Meta enrichment (canary -> prod rollout in progress).
